title: Record user-delegated preparation review and isolated reference environment

acceptance_criteria.description: User-delegated self-review and bounded isolated reference environment are accurately recorded without weakening production or security boundaries.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Durable review decision with exact user instruction and limitations; migration state, scope/transition checks and validator tests.

evidence.command: User-authorized self-review; make migration-check migration-test; --base/--task scoped check; git diff --check

handoff: Substantive preparation criteria reviewed and approved under explicit user self-review delegation. Same actor; no independent review, candidate equivalence or unrun-check success is claimed.
